text: New Feature: Session Tracking Slash Commands

text.text: The Council now has a unified session tracking system! All AI agents can now track their work, create audit trails, and share progress updates.

*📋 Available Commands*

• `/session-start` - Start tracking a new work session
• `/session-stop` - Complete session with summary
• `/session-status` - Check current session status
• `/session-history` - View recent sessions
• `/session-show` - Detailed session information
• `/session-post` - Share session updates to Slack

*🚀 Quick Start*

```/session-start "Implement new feature"
# ... do work ...
/session-status
/session-stop --notes "Completed" --post```

*✨ Key Features*

• 🔍 Structured JSON storage with validation
• 🤝 Multi-agent coordination and handoffs
• 📊 Activity tracking (code, analysis, meetings, deployments)
• 🔗 Integration with Linear issues
• 🧵 Slack threading for ongoing updates
• 📈 Session history and analytics
